bullets.id: Emas spot menutup pekan di sekitar $4.165, turun sekitar 0,58% sepekan. Emas dibuka pekan ini di $4.193,59, sempat ke $4.216,91 pada Senin, lalu jatuh ke $4.073,35 pada Rabu setelah CPI September naik 3,7% yoy, di atas perkiraan, dan PPI juga lebih panas. Pemulihan berikutnya tertahan di bawah $4.200.
bullets.en: Spot gold ended the week near $4,165, down about 0.58% on the week. It opened the week at $4,193.59, reached $4,216.91 on Monday, then fell to $4,073.35 on Wednesday after September CPI rose 3.7% y/y, above expectations, and PPI also ran hot. The rebound that followed stalled below $4,200.

bullets.id: Survei mingguan Kitco: dari 12 analis Wall Street, 6 (50%) netral, 4 (33%) bullish dan 2 (17%) bearish. Dari 139 responden Main Street, 63 (45%) bearish, 60 (43%) bullish dan 16 (12%) netral. Yield 10 tahun sempat ke 5,299% sebelum turun tajam pada Kamis, dolar melemah untuk pertama kali dalam lima pekan, dan kurva masih memperhitungkan kenaikan suku bunga sekitar 70 bps.
bullets.en: Kitco’s weekly survey: of 12 Wall Street analysts, 6 (50%) are neutral, 4 (33%) bullish and 2 (17%) bearish. Of 139 Main Street respondents, 63 (45%) are bearish, 60 (43%) bullish and 16 (12%) neutral. The 10-year yield peaked at 5.299% before falling sharply on Thursday, the dollar weakened for the first time in five weeks, and the curve still prices about 70 bps of rate hikes.

bullets.id: Level yang disebut analis: support $4.154 dan resistance $4.179 (Aslam), support dekat $4.100 (Razaqzada). Emas turun sekitar 4% sebulan dan sekitar 25,7% di bawah rekor Januari $5.608,35. Pekan depan relatif sepi: housing starts dan pending home sales (Selasa), klaim pengangguran (Kamis), PMI flash S&P Global dan sentimen konsumen final (Jumat).
bullets.en: Levels analysts cite: support at $4,154 and resistance at $4,179 (Aslam), support near $4,100 (Razaqzada). Gold is down about 4% on the month and about 25.7% below its January record of $5,608.35. Next week is light: housing starts and pending home sales (Tuesday), jobless claims (Thursday), S&P Global flash PMIs and final consumer sentiment (Friday).

bullets.id: Harga Antam terakhir yang terkonfirmasi tetap Rp2.572.000/gram dengan buyback Rp2.387.000 (spread sekitar 7,2%); belum ada pembaruan Minggu. Galeri24 naik Rp6.000 ke Rp2.523.000 (buyback Rp2.375.000, spread sekitar 5,9%) dan UBS naik Rp7.000 ke Rp2.548.000 (buyback Rp2.349.000, spread sekitar 7,8%).
bullets.en: Antam’s latest confirmed price stays at Rp2,572,000/gram with a Rp2,387,000 buyback (spread about 7.2%); there is no Sunday update yet. Galeri24 rose Rp6,000 to Rp2,523,000 (buyback Rp2,375,000, spread about 5.9%) and UBS rose Rp7,000 to Rp2,548,000 (buyback Rp2,349,000, spread about 7.8%).
